Marilyn: That sounds lovely, Carolyn. Thank you for inviting me. I'd love to join.

Despite the friendly interactions outside of work, Carolyn feels that Marilyn is still maintaining a professional distance at the bank. This perception leads Carolyn to feel disappointed, prompting her to address the issue directly.
